question: A closed loop $C$ **encloses all three** long straight wires carrying currents: $I_1 = 2$ A (into the page), $I_2 = 5$ A (out of the page), and $I_3 = 1$ A (into the page). Calculate the value of the line integral of the magnetic field $\oint \vec{B} \cdot d\vec{l}$ along the loop $C$, assuming the loop is traversed counter-clockwise.
